answer.reason: Gozan is where the Assyrian kings settled the exiles of Israel, and its people were destroyed by the Assyrian kings.

clauses.english: was where the king of Assyria placed the Israelites he carried away from Samaria
clauses.quote: placed them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan

clauses.english: was destroyed by the kings of Assyria, and its gods did not deliver it
clauses.quote: Have the gods of the nations delivered them which my fathers have destroyed; as Gozan

doubts: 1CH 5:26 also names the river Gozan as a place of exile for Reuben, Gad and half Manasseh, but it was left out as the same event as the first clause.
ISA 37:12 repeats 2KI 19:12 and was not cited separately.
